annotations.title: Transcribe audio: speech to text with Whisper

description: Transcribe audio to text: send an audio file URL (or POST the file) and get the transcript, detected language, duration and word count from Whisper large-v3-turbo; subtitles=srt or vtt adds subtitles, timestamps=true adds timed segments and words. MP3, WAV, M4A and OGG up to 5 MB, 90+ languages. Use for voice notes, meeting and podcast clips, call recordings and subtitles. Example: url=https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/En-us-hello.ogg. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

language.description: Spoken language code such as en, sv or de (default: detected)

subtitles.description: srt or vtt: also return subtitle text

timestamps.description: true: also return timed segments and words

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of an audio file (max 5 MB); or POST the file itself (raw body, multipart `file` part, or base64 in JSON)

name: audio_transcribe
